name: Midnight Ride
source:
Serena ended up all alone in the middle of nowhere... in the dead of the night.
Can you get her home unmolested?

[From [url=https://nidma.itch.io/midnight-ride]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
瑟琳娜最终独自一人在一个偏僻的地方……在夜深人静的时候。
你能平安无事地送她回家吗？

[来自[url=https://nidma.itch.io/midnight-ride]Itch.io[/url]]
